say:1:1130819001:0.text: Ah? No wonder! They've been quiet lately, and not much stuff is coming in!
say:1:1130819001:0.source_cn: 啊？难怪！最近他们的活动减少，已经很久没有东西运过来了！
say:1:1130819001:0.male: Ah? No wonder! They've been quiet lately, and not much stuff is coming in!
say:1:1130819001:0.female: Ah? No wonder! They've been quiet lately, and not much stuff is coming in!

say:2:1130819002:1.text: I knew this business wouldn't last. Those Quicksand Claws were too bold. It was only a matter of time before they punched above their weight.
say:2:1130819002:1.source_cn: 我早就知道这坐享其成的生意做不长，流沙之爪这么猖獗，肯...
say:2:1130819002:1.male: I knew this business wouldn't last. Those Quicksand Claws were too bold. It was only a matter of time before they punched above their weight.
say:2:1130819002:1.female: I knew this business wouldn't last. Those Quicksand Claws were too bold. It was only a matter of time before they punched above their weight.

say:3:1130819003:1.text: But I didn't expect this day to come so soon... alas.
say:3:1130819003:1.source_cn: 但这一天来得也太快了……唉。
say:3:1130819003:1.male: But I didn't expect this day to come so soon... alas.
say:3:1130819003:1.female: But I didn't expect this day to come so soon... alas.
